name: Quodd
tagline: Institutional market data APIs for equities, options, and related feeds
description: QUODD provides credentialed REST and gRPC market-data APIs, with public developer documentation covering equity snapshots, options data, ticker information, and related services. API access requires a trial or firm account, and a time-limited free trial is publicly offered.

auth.details: Commercial/partner credentials; public self-serve auth method not clearly documented on the marketing site

pricing.free_tier_limits: 7-day trial; credits vary by service from 5 or 10 up to 250. One request may consume multiple hits depending on the symbols and data returned.
pricing.paid_plans: Enterprise/commercial pricing; contact Quodd sales (not published self-serve)

rate_limits: All QUODD web services include unlimited usage with no per-call charges; technical concurrency and throughput limits are not publicly specified.
use_cases: look up equity quotes for a ticker
retrieve options chain or options market data
integrate delayed or real-time market data into a financial app
power portfolio or watchlist market data displays
